name: finverify-monorepo
description: FinVerify — verification infrastructure for AI. @finverify/core is the reusable, provider-agnostic verification engine; apps/* are thin clients (Chrome Extension today; VS Code, Desktop, Enterprise Dashboard, and agent integrations are meant to consume the same core package).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @finverify/core && npm run build -w @finverify/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @finverify/core && npm run typecheck -w @finverify/extension
